term.definition: Relates one addressable New Ithkuil root resource to one independently identified semantic sense concept parsed for that root.
term.source_justification: The real Chapter 2 row LEXSENSE-e3f64d03c6f6ec records the BSC STEM 1 sense of root LEXROOT-01e02023f505ec; the root and sense have separate stable identities.
term.skos_gap: SKOS semantic relations have skos:Concept domain and range, while the root is deliberately an addressable rdfs:Resource rather than a semantic concept; broader/narrower/related would also assert the wrong semantic relation.
term.rdf_gap: dcterms:hasPart states physical or logical inclusion rather than lexical sense membership; OntoLex sense requires adopting LexicalEntry and LexicalSense classes not otherwise used by this profile; generic rdfs:seeAlso cannot state the root-to-sense role.
